productsAndServices.description: An open source platform for sending push notifications, email, SMS, and other messages to users, enabling segmentation, retargeting, and personalized messaging across multiple channels.

productsAndServices.name: Laudspeaker Mobile SDKs

productsAndServices.description: A visual tool to design and automate multi-step, omnichannel customer messaging flows with branching logic and personalization.
productsAndServices.name: Journey Builder

productsAndServices.description: A tool to create dynamic user segments based on real-time attributes, events, and behaviors for targeted messaging.
productsAndServices.name: Segment Builder

productsAndServices.description: A no-code message template creator for designing personalized push, email, SMS, and in-app messages.
productsAndServices.name: Template Builder

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Pre Seed round raised $125,000, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,341,154 to $2,341,154, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 24 (-5 over 90 days) and market heat at 63 (-17).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
